snippet.title: Restore - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Store: https://saikeystudios.com/product/Restore/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3670820/Restore/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post

In this RPG, take on the role of Shouichi, who is summoned to another world alongside Azuha and Emily. With your abilities sealed, you'll need to rely on your wits and teamwork to survive. Will you be able to protect your friends and get them back home safely?
